name: Amou Takuya
source:
A novice actor in "The Wandering Angels."

After Akiomi Mondo, the actor for the main rival in [I]Au Revoir[/I], was taken to the hospital for food poisoning, director [url=/c93383]Oarai[/url] assigned Amo to take up his role. Despite his credible performance, his inexperience showed when he forgot to attach the rigging to himself for a wire action scene, resulting in [url=/c129987]Tozuka Yukio[/url] having to stealthily attach it mid-performance. The show's producer, [url=/c129739]Sukozawa[/url], sent Amo, Tozuka, and [url=/c129986]Shin'ichi Bandoto[/url] return the defective dry ice machine to [url=/c74743]Endo Electronics[/url].

[Edited from in-game TIPS]

[spoiler]Once [url=/c73543]Minorikawa[/url] informed them that they could discard the dry ice machine, the trio allowed [url=/c73541]Kano[/url] to take it, using it to deactivate [url=/c74615]Alphard[/url]'s bomb and save the Scramble.[/spoiler]
